title: Storybook Views & an Unforgettable Day with Mariela
text:
Such an amazing experience! The medieval villages were charming, the waterfall beautiful, and the panoramic trails had incredible views at every turn. Mariela made the day so fun and easy with her great energy and local knowledge.
The meal at the end was delicious and the perfect way to wrap it all up. Highly recommend!
author: Meander322668

title: Shoulder season- best time to go
text: Our guide Sam was phenomenal. At the end of October, the weather was perfect and there were almost no tourists in the town. Rupit is beautiful and the hike was moderate. Best for people who can hike up and down and on uneven surfaces. The restaurant we ate at after the hike was exceptional.
author: katyhX2315RA

title: Another area that makes Barcelona a must go
text: The beauty and peace waiting just outside of Barcelona is a must to experience. Sam,  our guide, was phenomenal . Eating in Rupit is not to be missed.
author: Martin_S

title: Amazing Hike in the Pyrenees
text: 5 Star Excursion. Tour guide, Anthony, was fantastic.  Hike was challenging, but the views were amazing. Village is very picturesque and lunch was delicious.
author: Rosanne_K

title: Spectacular hike in the Pyrenees
text: This was a 5 star experience. Our guide, Anthony, was superb. The hike was challenging, but the views were spectacular!  The lunch was delicious and the village very picturesque. We highly recommend this tour for people who want to get out into the countryside around Barcelona and enjoy hiking.
author: rosannek735

title: A Hiking we will go!
text: My husband actually booked this excursion.  I read previous reviews and it sounded like a nice way to get out of Barcelona and see the countryside.  Antoine is an excellent guide and we had a great time hiking up and down and up and down on rocky paths, stairs, steps, across streams etc. as he pointed out trees, plants, views and whatever else we needed to know about along the way.  I will say this is most definitely a HIKE and I would not recommend it unless you are prepared be climbing on uneven terrain with obstacles.  My husband and I are 67 years old we did this however were challenged at
author: Roger_G

title: What a treat!!! Simply Outstanding!
text: This is the highlight of our Barcelona stay. Having been here before twice, we decided to get out of the hustle and bustle city and what a pleaant surprise for us. Mariela, our guide, is just amazing. She's so knowledgeable with a passion for this trip. The hike was so amazing and we have shifted some serious calories 😅. The views were just out of this world. We finished our tour with the most scrumptious 3 course Catalunya food with good wine and liquor. Thank you Mariela for making this such a memorable day for us xx
author: LauraLeeKeow_W

title: exceeded our expectations
text:
One of our favourite tours of our 5 week trip.
Craig our guide was awesome, he obviously loves his job and is very knowledgable about the areas. Views were stunning and the lunch at the end in Rupit just topped off a really fun day. Would highly recommend this tour.
author: Michael_C

title: Great day trip from Barcelona!
text: Possibly our favorite day during our stay in Barcelona.  Visiting Rupit and the hike around the countryside was so enjoyable.  Plus the lunch was delicious!
author: Jodi_C

title: Brilliant day - real highlight of our Barcelona visit
text: We had a fantastic day - real highlight of our 4 days Barcelona to get out to country side.. our tour guide Antoine was brilliant, a lovely French guy who was extremely knowledgeable on allot of European history, not just Spain.. we had a lovely day with him, and taking us to eat very traditional food up in the mountains that we had not tasted or experienced in the city… we were fortunate to be the only people on the tour that day, so extra lucky… totally recommend…
author: hollydW427RQ
